name: sh-a04df9f0-blind29
instr:
# Diagnosing 29 undocumented behaviour changes in mvdan/sh without a test suite

This software turns command text into a tree, writes that tree back out again, and carries the commands out; a couple of small terminal tools are built on top of it. It now gets a great many things wrong at once. Nothing about the language changed and nothing about the code using it changed, yet the same inputs that used to be handled correctly come back with different answers, and in several places something that used to be refused is accepted or something that used to work is refused outright.

The repository has received 29 separate undocumented edits.

Doing sums inside a double-parenthesis substitution goes wrong as soon as the operands are not plain decimal digits. A value whose digits are introduced by a leading 0x is no longer understood as such and yields a different figure, and a value written as a radix, a # separator and then its digits is wrong too, whichever radix and whichever letters or digits are used. Somewhere in the same numeric evaluation there is a third, much rarer slip: one unusual computation comes back with a figure that does not match what the same sum gives elsewhere, and it only shows up in a session that also echoes its commands.
